data.name: Ahlebad
data.gender_notes: Ahlebad is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A title given to the companions of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), signifying trust, loyalty, and devotion. The name Ahlebad carries the meaning “Companion of the Prophet” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ahlebad usually hope their child will grow to embody companion of the prophet and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of devotion, loyalty, and companionship with the Prophet
data.etymology: Ahlebad belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Companion of the Prophet.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ahlebad total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: أحلباد
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من أحلب و يعني من يملك أو يسيطر على الحلب
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم أحلباد مشتق من الجذر اللغوي 'أحلب' والذي يعني الحلب أو اللبن. في بعض التفاسير، يرتبط الاسم بمعاني القوة والسيطرة كونه مرتبطا برعاية أو تربية الحيوانات. وقد ورد في بعض المصادر أن الاسم يدل على الشخص الذي يملك أو يسيطر على موارد الحلب أو الألبان، مما يعطيه بعدا اقتصاديا واجتماعيا في بعض الثقافات الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: احلباد
in_urdu.meaning: احلباد کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جو دودھ یا حلب کے وسائل پر قابض ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: احلباد نام عربی جڑ 'أحلب' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے دودھ یا حلب کرنا۔ اردو میں، اس نام کو ایسے شخص کے طور پر سمجھا جاتا ہے جو دودھ یا حلب کے کاروبار پر قابض یا کنٹرول رکھتا ہے۔ یہ نام عام طور پر جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے درمیان پایا جاتا ہے، خاص طور پر پاکستان اور بھارت میں، جہاں اس کا تلفظ 'احلباد' کیا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अह्लेबाद
in_hindi.meaning: अह्लेबाद का अर्थ है दूध या दही का व्यवसाय करने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: अह्लेबाद नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है, जहां 'أحلب' का अर्थ है दूध या दही। इस नाम को भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में व्यापक रूप से प्रयोग किया जाता है, जहां इसे 'अह्लेबाद' के रूप में उच्चारित किया जाता है। यह नाम अक्सर उन व्यक्तियों को दिया जाता है जिनका व्यवसाय या परिवारिक पृष्ठभूमि दूध या दही के उत्पादन और बिक्री से जुड़ी होती है।

in_pashto.name: احلباد
in_pashto.meaning: احلباد د دودھ یا حلب کاروبار کو کنټرولوي
in_pashto.long_meaning: د احلباد نوم په عربي ژبه کې د 'أحلب' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې د دودھ یا حلب معنی ورکوي. په پښتو کې، دا نوم داسې یو شخص ته ورکول کیږي چې د دودھ یا حلب په کاروبار کې ښکیل وي یا یې کنټرول ولري. دا نوم په افغانستان او پاکستان کې د پښتنو مسلمو ټولنو کې موندل کیږي.

in_english.name: Ahlebad
in_english.meaning: Ahlebad means one who controls or owns milk or dairy
in_english.long_meaning: The name Ahlebad originates from the Arabic root 'أحلب' (ah-liba), which means 'to milk' or 'milk'. In Islamic tradition, names often reflect attributes or professions. Ahlebad is believed to signify a person who owns, controls, or is involved in the milk or dairy business. This name may have been used historically to denote individuals or families known for their expertise in herding or dairy production. The name carries a sense of responsibility and resource management, reflecting the importance of such professions in early Islamic societies.

data.cultural_impact: The term "Ahlebad" is a title of respect and honor given to those who were in close proximity to the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) and showed unwavering support and loyalty during his lifetime. This term is often used to refer to the early Muslim community, the Sahabah (Companions), and their successors, the Tabi'un (Followers). This term holds great significance in Islamic history and culture, as it represents the formative years of the Islamic Ummah (community) and the establishment of Islamic practices and traditions.
data.spiritual_significance: The term "Ahlebad" also carries deep spiritual significance in Islam. Being a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) meant having direct access to his teachings, guidance, and wisdom. It emphasizes the importance of adhering to the Quran and the Sunnah (the Prophet's example) and fostering a in-depth understanding of Islam.ahlebed can be seen as a model of righteousness and faithfulness, inspiring generations of Muslims to strive towards a closer relationship with Allah and embody the noble qualities of the Sahabah. The term is a reminder of the importance of maintaining a strong bond with the Prophet (peace be upon him) and the Islamic community, which is essential for spiritual growth and development in Islam.
